subject: Post-demo: procurement path & trial->paid readiness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-18T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: procurement path & trial->paid readiness

Hi Alex / Procurement team 

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and requested next steps so we stay aligned on converting the trial to a paid deployment: 

Recap (from today)
- Trial period: 4 weeks starting when Stellar flips billing (you asked about start date flexibility).
- Success criteria: 50k inference tokens/day across 2 production routes; <200ms median latency on the primary route; automated KV caching working on the main prompt set.
- Current trial usage (we'll attach a baseline usage report below).

Requested items for procurement/commercial readiness:
1) Procurement path: PO vs card  which does Stellar prefer for enterprise purchases? If PO, any standard terms (payment net30/45, legal redlines) we should expect?
2) Marketplace interest: Would Stellar prefer purchasing via AWS Marketplace (we can provide an AMI/marketplace listing) or direct contract + invoice? Marketplaces can make procurement faster for some teams.
3) Billing start date: If you plan to sign a PO, what is the earliest target sign date? We typically start billing on the agreed start date; if you want a delayed start (e.g., align to a fiscal month), we can accommodate.
4) PO contacts & SOW: If moving forward with a PO, please confirm the procurement contact and whether you need a brief SOW. I attached a draft SOW for review.

Attachments: Stellar_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, redwood_trial_usage_report.csv

Next steps / asks: 
- Alex: Can you confirm procurement path (PO vs card) and whether Marketplace would speed things up for you?
- Procurement: If PO, please share expected payment terms and a target sign date.

Happy to hop on a quick 15-min sync if that's easier.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stellarhealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-19T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement path & trial->paid readiness

Hi Marissa 

Great demo  thanks. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Procurement path: We prefer a PO for anything over $25k per year. For pilot/trial conversions under that threshold teams sometimes use corporate card, but this will likely exceed that.
2) Payment terms: Standard is Net30. We do have a limited set of pre-approved legal exceptions, but we'd flag any specific Redwood terms that differ from our standard MSA.
3) Marketplace: AWS Marketplace would be ideal and usually speeds sign-off for Cloud Ops teams, but our Finance org still wants a PO on record. If you can provide a marketplace listing + invoice/PO flow, that would be helpful.
4) Target sign date: Internal approval aims for mid-March; procurement would need final SOW + PO request by March 4 to hit a March 15 license start.

I reviewed the SOW draft quickly  a couple small scope clarifications (I'll list inline) but nothing blocking. I've looped in Procurement.

Thanks  Alex
Head of ML Platforms | Stellar Health
alex.johnson@stellarhealth.com
